FALSIFIER: if PSNR <= 32.43 (no RMSE gain), per-image U-Net N2I is structurally FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo (half-view info loss > the per-image denoising gain) -> iter-3 is the structural-floor datapoint (NAF/ram class) and further per-image tuning is futile; document the ceiling.
